description: Calculate the total funding cost (or income) for holding a perpetual futures position. Edge cases: sizeBase, entryPrice and days above zero; fundingRate a fraction per interval (0.0001 is 0.01%), either sign; intervalHours 0.25 to 24 (default 8); if funding exceeds the position notional there is no finite price shift that offsets it, which is an error. Not covered: a funding rate that changes during the hold, and price moves. Use when user asks "how much funding will I pay holding X days?" or "is funding eating my profit?". Returns: totalCost (positive = you pay, negative = you receive; in the coin for inverse), costPerDay, annualPct, totalPeriods, breakevenShift (size of the price move whose PnL equals the funding: up for a positive rate, down for a negative one, for either side).

contractType.description: linear = USDT-margined (default), inverse = coin-margined. For inverse, sizeBase is USD contracts and cost figures come out in the base coin.

fundingRate.description: Funding rate per funding interval as a DECIMAL FRACTION, not a percent: 0.0001 means 0.01%, so a quoted 0.0125% is 0.000125 (per 8h unless intervalHours says otherwise)

intervalHours.description: Hours between funding payments, which is the period fundingRate covers. Default 8 (3 payments a day); 1 on Hyperliquid, dYdX, Kraken and Backpack, 4 or 2 on some symbols of Binance, Bybit, OKX, Gate, KuCoin, MEXC, Aster and Phemex.
